CustomField.label: Price
CustomField.description: The price in GBP for this ticket category. Defaults to 0.00 to support free events. Copied to Event_Registration__c.Ticket_Price__c by a Before Save Flow in Epic 4 at the point of registration.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the ticket price in GBP. Set to 0.00 for free tickets. This price will be copied to each registration at the time of booking.
